https://www.inquirer.net/497047/dnd-no-b.body: “China has neither the right nor the moral basis to dictate to the Philippines how and with whom we cooperate to defend our sovereignty and national interests,” DND spokesperson Assistant Secretary Arsenio Andolong said in a statement. READ: DND: PH does not need Beijing’s permission on defense ties “We do not need Beijing’s permission regarding our relations with other nations, especially on matters of our defense and security,” he added. Andolong said China is fueling the very tensions it blamed on other countries. “China’s deceptive accusations against other countries of escalating tensions have gone too far, while it continues to use coercion, intimidation and force to assert its illegal claims in the West Philippine Sea and other waters,” he said. The DND issued its statement a day after Senior Col. Chen Xi, spokesperson for China’s Ministry of National Defense, accused certain Filipino politicians of drawing outside powers into the South China Sea dispute when asked about the Philippine-Australian defense pact. Chen claimed that such efforts would only heighten tensions and undermine regional stability. “Relevant nonregional countries should earnestly respect China’s sovereignty and rights and interests in the South China Sea, and stop meddling in the South China Sea issue,” Chen said in remarks shared by the Chinese Embassy in Manila on Thursday. In its statement, the Armed Forces of the Philippines said its efforts to strengthen territorial defense and maritime security were aimed at protecting the country and upholding the rules-based international order. “As a sovereign nation, the Philippines is free to pursue defense and security cooperation with like-minded countries,” the AFP said. https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.body: The Kano State Government dismissed allegations by former Governor Rabiu Kwankwaso that Governor Abba Yusuf instigated the Economic and Financial Crimes Commission ( EFCC ) to investigate him. In a statement by the Commissioner for Information and Internal Affairs, Sunusi Bature, the state government said Governor Yusuf was not involved in Mr Kwankwaso’s case with the anti-graft agency. “The government wishes to state categorically that Governor Abba Kabir Yusuf has absolutely no involvement in Kwankwaso’s dealings with the EFCC. Senator Kwankwaso has had engagements with the anti-corruption agency long before the emergence of the present administration in Kano State. “It is therefore wrong, misleading and politically motivated for him to associate Governor Yusuf with an issue that predates the current government,” the statement said. Earlier on Friday, Mr Kwankwaso—who is running as the 2027 vice-presidential candidate of the Nigeria Democratic Congress (NDC)—accused his former political protégé of abusing their 43-year relationship by weaponising state institutions against him and his political allies. Responding to claims of interference in opposition affairs, the state government also distanced Governor Yusuf from ongoing court cases involving the NDC. It stated that the legal proceedings stemmed from internal disagreements within the party and have nothing to do with the state administration. “It is becoming increasingly clear that Senator Kwankwaso is attempting to use Governor Yusuf as a convenient target to attract public sympathy and political relevance ahead of the 2027 general elections,” the statement read. The administration urged the former governor to focus on resolving the internal challenges within his political camp rather than blaming the state government for his political difficulties. “The government also rejects Kwankwaso’s attempt to link Governor Yusuf with the internal crisis and court cases involving the NDC. These are internal party matters arising from disagreements within the NDC, and the Kano State Government has no involvement whatsoever in the legal proceedings. Reiterating that Governor Yusuf was elected to deliver governance rather than engage in endless political disputes, the statement warned that voters in Kano are well-aware of current political developments. “You cannot win public sympathy through blackmail and unfounded allegations,” the government stated, adding that those relying on such tactics should prepare for the verdict of the electorate at the polls in 2027. The statement added that Governor Yusuf remains focused on development and the welfare of the people of Kano State
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.title_zh: 卡诺州政府驳斥Kwankwaso对州长Yusuf提出的经济和金融犯罪委员会指控
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.body_zh: 卡诺州政府驳斥了前州长拉比乌·克万克瓦索提出的指控，即州长阿巴·优素福怂恿经济和金融犯罪委员会（EFCC）调查他。州政府信息与内部事务专员苏努西·巴图雷发表声明称，优素福州长没有参与克万克瓦索与反腐机构之间的案件。声明称：“政府在此郑重声明，阿巴·卡比尔·优素福州长绝对没有参与克万克瓦索与经济和金融犯罪委员会之间的事务。克万克瓦索参议员早在卡诺州现任政府成立之前，就曾与反腐机构有过接触。因此，将优素福州长与早于现任政府的问题联系起来，是错误、误导且出于政治目的的做法。”此前星期五，正在竞选尼日利亚民主大会（NDC）2027年副总统候选人的克万克瓦索先生，指责这位昔日的政治门生滥用双方长达43年的关系，利用州级机构对付他及其政治盟友。针对干预反对派事务的指控，州政府也澄清，优素福州长与涉及NDC的 ongoing 法院案件无关。声明指出，这些法律程序源于该党内部分歧，与州政府毫无关系。声明称：“越来越明显的是，克万克瓦索参议员正试图把优素福州长当作便利的靶子，以在2027年大选前博取公众同情并提升自身政治影响力。”州政府敦促这位前州长专注于解决其政治阵营内部的挑战，而不是把政治困境归咎于州政府。声明说：“政府同样拒绝克万克瓦索试图将优素福州长与NDC内部危机和法院案件挂钩的做法。这些都是NDC内部因意见分歧而产生的党内事务，卡诺州政府绝对没有参与任何法律程序。再次强调，优素福州长当选是为了推进治理，而不是卷入无休止的政治争端。州政府警告说，卡诺州选民十分了解当前的政治局势。“你们无法通过勒索和毫无根据的指控赢得公众同情。”政府还补充称，利用此类手段的人应准备好在2027年投票时接受选民的裁决。声明最后指出，优素福州长仍专注于卡诺州的发展和人民福祉

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/p.body: Naresh, 46, recently donated 10 million won ($6,800) worth of goods to two welfare institutions in Yongsan District, where he has lived since arriving in Korea in 1999. The donation, presented last week with the district office, included medical equipment for people with severe disabilities and winter apparel for children at a local orphanage. At Yeongnak Ania's House, a facility for people with severe disabilities, he donated a specialized medical bed and two oxygen concentrators to improve care for its residents. At Yeongnak Borinwon, he provided children with seasonal clothing and shoes to keep them warm through the winter. The contribution is part of a broader commitment that began last year. Naresh donates approximately 1 million won worth of goods every month, selecting items according to the specific needs of each institution rather than making general cash contributions. His previous donations have included portable heaters for older residents and dehumidifiers, electric fans and cordless vacuum cleaners for the Yongsan Community Children's Center. Naresh runs Barnett & Company, a textile export business that he established after settling in Korea. His professional achievements include receiving the $5 million Export Tower Award at Korea's annual Trade Day ceremony in 2014, recognizing the company's export performance. But he has increasingly devoted attention to the community that has become his home over nearly three decades. “Cash donations are meaningful, too, but I find great satisfaction in thinking about what people who receive assistance need most urgently and personally delivering items tailored to those needs,” Naresh said. “Every time I visit these institutions and share a little warmth, I find that I gain the strength and energy to keep going myself.” He hopes his efforts will encourage others to contribute, however modestly. “If my small acts of kindness can inspire even one person to help a neighbor, that is enough for me,” he said, adding that he intends to continue giving. “We deeply appreciate his sincere commitment to giving back to the community he has called home for so many years, personally visiting local facilities every month to deliver items people truly need,” Yongsan District chief Kim Kyung-dae said as he expressed his gratitude for Naresh's continued generosity. “We will do our utmost to ensure that vulnerable residents are not left without support and to build a stronger, more comprehensive social care network, honoring the donor's generous spirit,” he added. Naresh's approach offers a practical reminder that effective philanthropy is not always about the size of a donation. Sometimes, it begins with showing up, listening and delivering exactly what someone needs. This article was published with the assistance of generative AI and edited by The Korea Times
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/p.title_zh: 印度商人将在韩国27年的经历变成回馈社会的使命
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/p.body_zh: 纳雷什现年46岁。他自1999年抵达韩国后一直居住在龙山區，最近向当地两家福利机构捐赠了价值1000万韩元（$6,800）的物资。上周，他与龙山区政府一同将这批物资移交，其中包括为重度残障人士使用的医疗设备，以及供当地孤儿院儿童穿着的冬季衣物。在为重度残障人士提供服务的Yeongnak Ania's House，他捐赠了一张专用医疗床和两台制氧机，以改善院住民的照护条件。在Yeongnak Borinwon，他向孩子们提供了换季衣物和鞋子，帮助他们度过寒冬。这份捐赠是始于去年的一项更大承诺的一部分。纳雷什每月都会捐赠价值约100万韩元的物资，他会根据各机构的具体需求挑选物品，而不是进行笼统的现金捐赠。他此前捐赠的物资包括供年长住民使用的便携式取暖器，以及供龙山社区儿童中心使用的除湿机、电风扇和无绳吸尘器。纳雷什经营Barnett & Company，这是一家他在韩国定居后创办的纺织品出口企业。他的职业成就包括在2014年韩国一年一度的贸易日颁奖仪式上获得价值$5 million的出口塔奖，以表彰该公司的出口业绩。但在近三十年里，随着龙山区逐渐成为他的家园，他也日益关注当地社区。纳雷什说：“现金捐赠同样有意义，但想到受助者最迫切需要什么，并亲自送上门符合这些需求的物品，会让我获得极大的满足感。每次探访这些机构，与大家分享一点温暖，我都会从中获得继续前行的力量和精力。”他希望自己的努力能够鼓励其他人参与贡献，无论贡献多少。他说：“如果我这些微小的善举能够激励哪怕一个人去帮助邻居，对我来说就已经足够了。”他还表示将继续给予帮助。龙山区区长金庆岱在感谢纳雷什持续慷慨捐赠时表示：“我们由衷感谢他多年来回馈这个被他称为家园的社区，并每月亲自走访当地机构，送上人们真正需要的物资。我们将竭尽全力，确保弱势住民不会陷入无人支持的局面，并建设更强大、更全面的社会照护网络，以彰显捐赠者慷慨奉献的精神。”纳雷什的做法切实表明，有效的慈善事业并不总取决于捐赠金额。有时，它始于亲自到场、倾听需求，以及准确送出某个人所需要的物品。本文在生成式人工智能协助下完成，并由《韩国时报》编辑。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/oth.body: Local officials use maritime heritage to foster ties with a growing expat community For many foreign residents living in Incheon’s gleaming, master-planned business districts, daily life revolves around glass office towers, international schools and expressways linking them to Seoul. Last week, a group of foreign residents traded that futuristic skyline for coastal boardwalks and tidal flats, exploring the islands and maritime heritage tucked just minutes from their doorstep. Thirty-nine international residents of the Incheon Free Economic Zone took part in a field excursion organized by the zone’s authority to deepen their connection to the port city’s coastal geography and local history. Departing from G-Tower in Songdo, the participants spent the day touring Muui Island and Yeongjong Island, two coastal destinations on Korea’s west coast. The program reflects a broader push by Incheon officials to help foreign professionals, researchers and students put down lasting roots. Established in 2003 as Korea’s first free economic zone, the Incheon Free Economic Zone (IFEZ) — encompassing Songdo, Yeongjong and Cheongna — has grown into a major hub for global biopharmaceutical firms, international organizations and logistics companies. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/oth.title_zh: 仁川外籍居民走出高层建筑，探索附近岛屿
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/oth.body_zh: 当地官员利用海洋文化遗产促进与日益壮大的外籍人士社区的联系。对于居住在仁川光鲜亮丽、总体规划完善商务区的许多外国居民来说，日常生活围绕着玻璃幕墙写字楼、国际学校以及连接这些区域与首尔的高速公路展开。上周，一群外国居民暂时离开未来感十足的城市天际线，前往滨海步道和潮滩，探索距离他们家门仅几分钟路程的岛屿与海洋文化遗产。仁川自由经济区的39名国际居民参加了该区管理机构组织的外出考察活动，以加深他们与这座港口城市的沿海地理环境和地方历史的联系。考察团从松岛G-Tower出发，耗时一整天游览位于韩国西海岸的两个滨海目的地——木浦岛和灵ong岛。该项目反映出仁川官员正在推动的一项更广泛工作，即帮助外国专业人士、研究人员和学生在这座城市扎根。仁川自由经济区（IFEZ）成立于2003年，是韩国首个自由经济_zone，涵盖松岛、灵ong和清雅，已发展成为全球生物制药企业、国际组织和物流公司的重要枢纽。然而，官员们长期以来指出，留住全球人才需要的不只是税收优惠和现代化基础设施，还要帮助新来者在周边社区中感受到归属感。仁川已成为韩国国际居民最多的地区之一。根据内政安全部上月发布的数据，仁川有174,824名外国居民，占全市人口的5.7%，这一总数在韩国所有城市和省份中位居第四。行程从木浦岛开始，参与者沿着水上滨海步道行走，参观하나개海滩，欣赏西海泥滩和海岸线的壮阔景色。随后，一行人前往灵ong岛，在海边公园骑乘往返长5.6公里的观光铁路自行车道。行程还穿插介绍了仁川的海洋历史，途中停靠灵ongjin海滩、历史悠久的泰蓬莱亭以及郭乙八所——一处传统渡轮码头区域，曾是连接该岛与大陆的重要门户。一名参与者说：“即使生活在仁川，我对其岛屿和海洋景点也知之甚少，很少有机会亲自体验。探索自然风光并尝试不同的活动，让我发现了这座城市的新一面。”该机构投资招揽规划部门主任林美淑表示，机构计划继续扩大根据外籍人士兴趣量身定制的文化和区域项目，鼓励他们融入社区并长期定居。通过仁川自由经济区全球中心，该机构定期为松岛、灵ong和清雅的外国居民提供韩语课程、定居咨询和文化工作坊。本文在生成式人工智能协助下由《韩国时报》刊登并编辑。

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026112802.body: (서울=연합뉴스) 장재은 기자 = 미국의 인공지능(AI) 데이터센터 건설 붐 때문에 미국 방산업계가 생산에 심각한 차질을 빚는 것으로 전해졌다. 데이터센터가 항공우주·방위산업과 인력, 원자재, 부품의 공급망을 대부분 공유하는 여건에서 나타난 'AI 구축효과'의 단적인 사례로 주목된다. 27일(현지시간) 파이낸셜타임스(FT)에 따르면 미국항공우주산업협회(AIA) 에릭 패닝 최고경영자(CEO)는 빅테크의 공격적 AI 데이터센터 투자 때문에 비용이 급등하고 있다고 지적했다. 패닝 CEO는 "하이퍼스케일링(초대형 데이터센터 확장)이 인력, 부지, 에너지 등 시장에서 모든 것을 빨아들이고 있다"며 "AI 산업이 우리 산업에 실질적인 경쟁 문제로 부상했다"고 말했다. 그는 "빅테크의 화수분 같은 자금력 때문에 가뜩이나 항공 여행 급증과 국방비 지출 확대로 압박받던 업계의 부담이 커지고 있다"고 강조했다. 주요 방산업체들도 우크라이나와 러시아의 전쟁, 미국과 이란의 전쟁에 따른 미국 국방부의 탄약 증산 요구를 맞추는 데 생산 차질을 빚고 있다. 이 같은 병목 현상의 배경에는 그간 항공우주, 방산업체가 비용 절감을 위해 부품 수천개를 단일 공급업체에 의존해온 수십 년 관행이 있다. 코로나19의 팬데믹 이후 심화한 인플레이션, 숙련공 부족, 미국의 생산기지 국내 복귀에 더해 AI 데이터센터 건설 붐이 결정타로 작용하고 있다. 대형 신규 공장을 짓는 항공우주·방산 기업들은 철강부터 전자 스위치, 공조 시스템에 이르는 핵심 인프라 시공사와 공급업체를 확보하는 경쟁에서 데이터센터 건설사들에 밀려나는 것으로 전해진다. 패닝 CEO는 "미국 항공우주·방산 업계는 2025년 거의 1조 달러에 달하는 매출을 올렸지만 생산 물량 자체가 적어 구매력이 떨어진다"며 "가전이나 데이터센터, 자동차 산업만큼 대량 구매를 하지 못해 시장을 주도할 수 없는 구조"라고 배경을 설명했다. 그는 최근 AI 수요 때문에 가격이 급등한 메모리 반도체를 대표적 사례로 꼽으며 반도체 제조사들이 기존 항공우주·방산용 구형 칩을 만들던 공장라인마저 AI 등 첨단기술 분야로 돌리고 있다고 실태를 전했다. 뱅크오브아메리카(BoA)의 론 엡스타인 애널리스트는 하이퍼스케일러(대형 클라우드 기업)들이 터빈 날개, 주물 같은 핵심 부품뿐만 아니라 회로기판처럼 눈에 띄지 않는 영역까지 항공우주·방산 업계와 공급망을 공유하고 있다고 지적했다. 최근 산업계에는 AI가 생산성 향상을 통해 다른 산업의 성장을 촉진하기보다 자원과 인력을 선점해 오히려 성장을 제약한다는 우려가 제기되고 있다. 이른바 'AI 구축효과'로, 막대한 자본을 앞세운 빅테크의 AI 인프라 투자가 자금뿐만 아니라 전력, 원자재, 숙련 노동자까지 싹쓸이하면서 여타 제조업의 생산과 투자를 밀어내는 리스크로 부상하고 있다는 얘기다. 시장에서는 이 같은 과도한 자원 쏠림 현상 때문에 제조업 공급망에 병목현상이 생기고 비용이 증가해 실물경제 전반의 성장 기반이 약해질 수 있다는 지적이 나온다. 제보는 카카오톡 okjebo <저작권자(c) 연합뉴스, 무단 전재-재배포, AI 학습 및 활용 금지> 2026/11/28 09:09 송고 2026년11월28일 09시09분 송고
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026112802.title_zh: “人工智能正在吞噬一切”：数据中心被归咎于美国国防工业生产也受扰
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026112802.body_zh: （首尔＝韩联社）记者张宰恩报道称，美国人工智能数据中心建设热潮导致美国国防工业生产遭遇严重阻碍。在数据中心与航空航天、国防产业共享大部分人力、原材料和零部件供应链的背景下，这一现象被视为“AI构建效应”的典型案例而受到关注。据《金融时报》27日（当地时间）报道，美国航空航天工业协会（AIA）首席执行官埃里克·潘宁指出，由于大型科技企业激进投资人工智能数据中心，成本正在急剧上涨。潘宁首席执行官表示：“超大规模建设（扩建超大型数据中心）正在吞噬市场上的人力、土地、能源等所有资源。人工智能产业已经成为对我们产业构成实质性竞争的问题。”他强调：“凭借大型科技企业如洪水般庞大的资金实力，本已因航空旅行激增和国防开支扩大而承受压力的行业，负担正在进一步加重。”主要国防企业也因乌克兰与俄罗斯战争、美国与伊朗战争引发的美国国防部增产弹药要求而遭遇生产障碍。这种瓶颈现象的背后，是航空航天和国防企业数十年来为削减成本而形成的惯例，即数千种零部件往往依赖单一供应商。新冠疫情后加剧的通货膨胀、熟练工人短缺、美国生产基地回流国内，再加上人工智能数据中心建设热潮，成为造成瓶颈的决定性因素。正在建设大型新工厂的航空航天和国防企业在争取核心基础设施施工方与供应商方面败给数据中心建设企业，争夺范围从钢铁到电子开关、空调系统。潘宁首席执行官解释背景称：“美国航空航天和国防产业虽然实现了接近1万亿美元的营收，但实际产量偏低，购买力随之下降。由于无法像家电、数据中心和汽车产业那样进行大规模采购，产业无法主导市场。”他列举了近期因人工智能需求而价格飞涨的存储芯片这一典型案例，并说明，半导体制造商甚至把原本用于生产航空航天和国防旧款芯片的工厂生产线，转向人工智能等先进技术领域。美国银行（BoA）分析师罗恩·埃普斯坦指出，大型云计算企业不仅在涡轮机叶片、铸件等核心零部件上与航空航天和国防产业共享供应链，甚至在电路板等不显眼领域也与该产业共享供应链。最近，产业界开始担忧，人工智能通过提高生产率促进其他产业增长的同时，却抢占资源和人力，反而制约增长。所谓的“AI构建效应”表现为：掌握巨额资本的大型科技企业投资人工智能基础设施，不仅投入资金，还大量占用电力、原材料和熟练劳动力，进而挤压其他制造业的生产和投资。市场有人指出，这种资源过度集中现象导致制造业供应链出现瓶颈、成本上升，并可能削弱实体经济整体的增长基础。报道称，可在KakaoTalk搜索okjebo获取。Copyright(c) 韩联社，未经许可禁止转载和再分发，禁止用于人工智能学习及使用。2026年11月28日09:09发布，2026年11月28日09时09分发布

https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/2027.body: UMUAHIA — Presidential candidate of the Nigeria Democratic Congress (NDC), Mr Peter Obi, has said President Bola Tinubu must be voted out in the 2027 presidential election for Nigeria to experience the change and development it desires. Obi, who spoke on Friday at the Primetime Event Centre, along the Port Harcourt-Aba Expressway, Aba, Abia State, accused the Tinubu administration of failing to fulfil its campaign promises and worsening poverty in the country. He assured residents that the government he and his running mate, Senator Rabiu Kwankwaso, were seeking to form would unite the country and transform its economic and social sectors. The former Anambra State governor said the presidency required energy and commitment, arguing that it should not be treated as a retirement home. “Tinubu has failed to fulfil all his promises, including the restoration of the power sector. We will generate, transmit and distribute at least 10,000MW. Any money we borrow must be for investment. “The presidency requires energy; it is not a retirement home. We are tired of Tinubu’s government. Tinubu must go for a better Nigeria to emerge,” he said. Obi said his proposed administration would prioritise national unity, recalling that Nigeria had previously enjoyed stronger bonds across its different regions. “Let me assure you that the government Kwankwaso and I are seeking to form will unite Nigeria. Yesterday, I was in Minna, and I told them that Nigeria used to be united. No wonder Nnamdi Azikiwe and Chukwuemeka Ojukwu were born in Zungeru. We are going to reunite Nigeria. “The Nigeria we want is one where a child of nobody can become somebody,” he said. He also criticised the Federal Government’s borrowing, alleging that the Tinubu administration had borrowed more than previous administrations combined without commensurate visible results. According to him, his proposed government would focus on production, job creation and economic prosperity rather than continued dependence on consumption. “Kwankwaso and I want to form a government that will not give you excuses. We are going to form a government that will bring prosperity and production back to Nigeria. We will remove this country from consumption to production. “We already know the excuses, and we will tackle the challenges. https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/2027.body_zh: 乌穆阿希亚——尼日利亚民主大会党（NDC）总统候选人彼得·奥比先生说，为了让尼日利亚实现其期望的变革与发展，总统博拉·蒂努布必须在2027年总统选举中被选下台。奥比周五在位于阿巴州阿巴、波特哈科特—阿巴高速公路沿线的Primetime Event Centre发表讲话，指责蒂努布政府未能兑现竞选承诺，并加剧了尼日利亚的贫困。他向当地居民保证，他和竞选搭档拉比乌·夸克瓦索参议员力图组建的政府将团结全国，并改造尼日利亚的经济和社会部门。前阿南布拉州州长表示，总统职位需要精力和投入，不应被视为养老院。“蒂努布没有兑现他作出的所有承诺，包括恢复电力行业。我们将至少发电、输电和配电10,000MW。我们借的任何资金都必须用于投资。“总统职位需要精力；它不是养老院。我们已经厌倦了蒂努布政府。蒂努布必须下台，尼日利亚才能迎来更美好的未来。”他说。奥比表示，他提出的政府将把国家团结置于优先位置，并回顾称，尼日利亚过去曾在不同地区之间拥有更牢固的联系。“我向你们保证，夸克瓦索和我力图组建的政府将团结尼日利亚。昨天，我去了米纳，并告诉他们，尼日利亚曾经是团结的。难怪纳姆迪·阿齐克韦和楚克维梅卡·奥朱克沃都出生在宗格鲁。我们将让尼日利亚重新团结起来。“我们想要的尼日利亚，是一个任何出身普通的孩子都能成为有所作为之人的国家。”他说。他还批评联邦政府的举债行为，指称蒂努布政府借入的债务超过历届政府总和，却没有取得与之相称的明显成果。据他表示，他提出的政府将专注于生产、就业创造和经济繁荣，而不是继续依赖消费。“夸克瓦索和我想组建一个不会让你们有借口可推的政府。我们将组建一个让繁荣和生产回归尼日利亚的政府。我们将使这个国家从消费转向生产。“我们已经知道人们会找哪些借口，我们将应对这些挑战。我们的政府将展现同情心、投入精神以及把事情办成的热忱。”他说。谈到腐败问题，奥比承诺，他的政府将确保公共资金得到运用，让尼日利亚人民受益。他质疑政府贷款的使用情况，并将当前举债与此前的重大基础设施投资进行对比，例如凯恩吉大坝。奥比进一步声称，生活在贫困中的尼日利亚人已从蒂努布就任时的8700万增加到超过1.4亿。他还表达了对青年失业问题的担忧，并承诺如果当选，将增加对教育和医疗保健的投资。谈到阿巴州经济时，NDC候选人承诺在政府任头几年内，把该州商业中心阿巴打造为出口枢纽，并将其与波特哈科特连接起来，建立新的经济走廊。他还承诺解决尼日利亚面临的安全挑战，尤其是学童遭绑架问题。“在学童仍遭绑架、其他人被带入丛林的情况下，我们不能执政。我们会进入那片丛林与他们在一起。”奥比说。本文所载评论不代表Vanguard报纸及其任何员工的观点

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026112712.body_zh: （首尔=韩联社）记者郑慧仁=下周（11月30日至12月4日），InterX等8家企业将面向机构投资者进行需求预测，YouCast将登陆科斯达克市场。临近年末，继新股普通认购未达到目标之后，陆续有企业推迟招股时间或撤回上市计划。据金融投资业界28日报道，第五代移动通信（5G）专网专业企业YouCast将于30日登陆科斯达克市场。此前，YouCast在18日至19日进行的普通认购中未达到认购目标。这是韩国IPO市场普通认购未达标的情况时隔约3年零10个月再次出现。Hope公募价格区间为13,000至16,500韩元，公司将在30日确定最终公募价格，并于次月1日至2日进行普通认购。制造人工智能（AI）企业InterX与空间信息人工智能（AI）企业Dabio将于30日至次月4日同步进行需求预测。电力转换设备专业制造企业Destin Power与船舶动力控制解决方案企业KTE将于次月2日至8日接受机构投资者评估。两家企业的Hope公募价格区间分别为8,000至11,000韩元和19,000至23,000韩元。沙拉及家庭便利食品（HMR）专业制造企业EMD Korea与企业级生成式AI解决方案企业Zenon将于次月3日至9日参加需求预测。已经启动需求预测的新药开发企业InnoBota Therapeutics与Mother's Pharma则将分别在次月2日和3日前接受机构订单。随着近期IPO市场投资情绪降温，陆续有企业推迟或取消原定于下周进行的招股安排。原定于30日参加机构需求预测的CS Chemicals因证券登记书修正而推迟日程，原定于次月3日进行需求预测的Taeseok Optical也推迟了安排。航空航天专业企业ANYH Structure在完成机构需求预测后撤回上市计划，同时取消了原定27日至30日进行的普通认购安排。继上周阿尔茨海默病治疗药物开发企业Adel撤回上市计划之后，完成机构需求预测后仍中止招股流程的案例接连出现。▲ CS Chemicals：科斯达克，5,400至6,800韩元（预计12月8日确定），11月30日至12月4日，新股认购12月10日至11日，主承销商KB Securities。▲ InterX：科斯达克，10,000至13,000韩元（预计12月8日确定），11月30日至12月4日，新股认购12月9日至10日，主承销商韩国投资证券、BNK投资证券。▲ Dabio：科斯达克，12,300至16,600韩元（预计12月8日确定），11月30日至12月4日，新股认购9日至10日，主承销商대신证券。▲ Mother's Pharma：科斯达克，11,000至14,500韩元（预计12月7日确定），11月27日至12月3日，新股认购8日至9日，主承销商KB Securities、NH投资证券。▲ InnoBota Therapeutics：科斯达克，20,000至24,000韩元（预计12月4日确定），11月26日至12月2日，新股认购12月7日至8日，主承销商韩国投资证券。▲ Destin Power：科斯达克，8,000至11,000韩元（预计12月10日确定），12月2日至8日，新股认购11日至14日，主承销商韩国投资证券。▲ KTE：科斯达克，19,000至23,000韩元（预计12月10日确定），12月2日至8日，新股认购14日至15日，主承销商NH投资证券。▲ EMD Korea：科斯达克，9,500至11,500韩元（预计12月11日确定），12月3日至9日，新股认购14日至15日，主承销商未来资产证券。▲ Zenon：科斯达克，9,700至12,200韩元（预计12月11日确定），12月3日至9日，新股认购12月14日至15日，主承销商三星证券。▲ Enki Hite：科斯达克，13,000至16,500韩元（预计11月30日确定），新股认购1日至2日，主承销商新英证券。报道可通过KakaoTalk okjebo联系。版权所有©韩联社，禁止擅自转载、再发布及用于AI学习与利用。2026年11月28日09:00发布，2026年11月28日09时00分发布

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026112801.summary: (서울=연합뉴스) 장재은 기자 = 국제신용평가사 스탠더드앤드푸어스(S&P)가 프랑스의 국가신용등급이 재정악화 때문에 강등될 가능성을 열어뒀다. S&P는 27일(현지시간) 프랑스의 신용등급을 기존 A+로 유지하되 등급 전망을 기존 '안정적'에서 '부정적'으로 변경한다고 밝혔다. A+는 10단계로 구성된 투자등급의 5번째로 채무의 상환능력은 양호하지만 경기변동에 다소 영향을 받는다는 의미다.

S&P는 27일(현지시간) 프랑스의 신용등급을 기존 A+로 유지하되 등급 전망을 기존 '안정적'에서 '부정적'으로 변경한다고 밝혔다. A+는 10단계로 구성된 투자등급의 5번째로 채무의 상환능력은 양호하지만 경기변동에 다소 영향을 받는다는 의미다. S&P는 "2027년 대통령 선거 이후를 비롯해 정치적 양극화가 계속되면 재정적자 감축 대책, 경제성장 촉진을 위한 개혁을 이행하는 데 제약이 있을 수 있다"고 지적했다. 그러면서 "부진한 경제 성장세와 채무상환 비용 때문에 재정적자 감축이 어려워지면서 재정적 난제가 커지고 있다는 점을 반영했다"고 등급 전망 하향의 근거를 제시했다. 앞서 지난달 말 피치도 프랑스의 재정 건전성 회복 가능성을 비관하며 신용등급 전망을 '부정적'으로 바꾼 바 있다. 이날 프랑스 통계청 발표에 따르면 프랑스는 올해 3분기 국내총생산(GDP)이 전분기 대비 0.2% 감소했다. 이는 1분기 -0.2%, 2분기 -0.02%에 이은 3개 분기 연속 역성장으로 기술적 경기침체로 규정될 수 있다. 프랑스는 10년물 국채 금리가 지난달 2002년 이후 최고인 5.14%까지 치솟은 데 이어 최근에도 4.7%대의 높은 수준을 유지하면서 국가채무에 대한 이자 비용이 눈덩이처럼 늘고 있다. 에마뉘엘 마크롱 프랑스 대통령이 문제를 해결하기 위해 430억 유로 규모의 긴축, 증세안을 추진하고 있으나 하원의 과반을 확보하지 못한 소수정부를 이끄는 탓에 어려움을 겪고 있다. 마크롱 대통령은 강행 처리 수단을 지니고는 있으나 그 경우 불신임 투표에 직면하거나 노동조합과 학생들이 거리에 나서 대규모 시위를 벌여 극도의 사회적 혼란이 초래될 위험이 있다. 여론조사 결과를 보면 프랑스는 내년 4∼5월 대선에서 기성정치에 대한 실망 속에 극우성향을 지닌 포퓰리스트 정당인 국민연합(RN)이 집권할 가능성이 커지고 있다. 제보는 카카오톡 okjebo <저작권자(c) 연합뉴스, 무단 전재-재배포, AI 학습 및 활용 금지> 2026/11/28 08:59 송고 2026년11월28일 08시59분 송고
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026112801.title_zh: 标普对法国信用评级前景持“负面”看法，警告其面临财政赤字和政治混乱
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026112801.body_zh: （首尔=韩联社）记者姜宰恩报道，国际信用评级机构标准普尔（S&P）为法国因财政恶化而遭降级保留了可能。S&P于当地时间27日表示，维持法国原有A+信用评级，但将评级展望从原来的“稳定”调整为“负面”。A+在由10个等级构成的投資级中位列第5，意味着偿债能力良好，但会受到经济波动的一定影响。S&P指出：“包括2027年总统选举之后在内，如果政治两极分化持续，可能会制约落实削减财政赤字的措施以及促进经济增长的改革。”该机构同时表示，下调评级展望的依据是：“这一调整反映了疲弱的经济增长和偿债成本使削减财政赤字愈发困难，财政难题正在加剧。”此前，评级机构皮奇蒂也在上月底对法国财政状况的恢复前景持悲观态度，将其信用评级展望调整为“负面”。据法国国家统计局当天公布的数据，法国今年第三季度国内生产总值（GDP）环比下降0.2%。继第一季度下降0.2%、第二季度下降0.02%后，这是经济连续三个季度负增长，按技术定义可视为陷入经济衰退。上月法国10年期国债收益率升至2002年以来最高的5.14%，近期仍维持在4.7%左右的高位，国家债务的利息负担正像滚雪球一样膨胀。法国总统埃马纽埃尔·马克龙正推动规模达430亿欧元的紧缩和增税方案，以解决这些问题，但领导一个未能赢得众议院过半席位的少数派政府使其举步维艰。马克龙总统虽有权强行推进方案，但这么做将面临不信任投票，或者引发工会和学生的远离，进而导致大规模示威，造成极度社会动荡。民意调查显示，在法国明年4月至5月举行的总统选举中，在对建制政治失望的情绪推动下，极右翼民粹主义政党国民联盟（RN）执掌政权的可能性正在上升。报道由KakaoTalk okjebo发送。版权所有(c) 韩联社，未经许可禁止转载或再发布，禁止用于人工智能训练及使用。2026/11/28 08:59发送，2026年11月28日08时59分发送。

https://leadership.ng/fg-targets-lower-g.body: In addition to direct payments, Government is considering offsetting outstanding debts against royalties and taxes that electricity producers owe the state. Negotiations are also underway with state-owned oil company NNPC Ltd to lower the price of gas supplied to power plants. Minister of Power Joseph Tegbe, said Nigeria expects to complete the repayment of outstanding debts to electricity producers in 2027, with more than a third of the negotiated amount already settled. Speaking on television channel Arise News on November 23, the Minister said the government had paid 1.23 trillion naira ($883 million) to the companies concerned. The total debt negotiated with producers was reduced to 3.3 trillion naira ($2.37 billion), down from an initial estimate of 6 trillion naira ($4.31 billion). The government intends to settle the remaining balance through a combination of payment mechanisms. Tegbe described the proposed reduction as a way to ease producers’ operating costs over the longer term. The measures address unpaid bills accumulated by power generation companies, known as GenCos, between February 2015 and March 2025. According to the Nigerian presidency, the repayment program approved by President Bola Tinubu in April 2026 covers verified debts from that period. By then, 15 power plants had signed agreements covering a portion of their recognized claims. To finance the initial payments, the government reported that it had raised 501 billion naira ($360 million) through a first bond issue. A second bond issue worth 729 billion naira ($523 million) was completed in September. On October 9, Nigerian Bulk Electricity Trading (NBET) announced that payments under the second round of financing had begun. To supplement direct payments, the government is exploring arrangements that would offset royalties owed by electricity producers against their outstanding claims on the state. Tegbe also raised the possibility of similar arrangements involving corporate income tax. Both mechanisms remain under discussion with the companies concerned. According to the minister, such arrangements would eliminate the need for the government to collect money from producers only to return it through debt repayments. He also noted that public resources must be allocated across several sectors, including education, healthcare, and agriculture. These competing budget demands are among the reasons the government is exploring alternatives to direct payments. Beyond the settlement of existing arrears, preventing the accumulation of new debt remains a major challenge. In July, the Association of Power Generation Companies estimated that new arrears might exceed 7 trillion naira (approximately $5.02 billion) before the repayment program is completed. https://leadership.ng/fg-targets-lower-g.title_zh: 尼日利亚联邦政府瞄准降低天然气价格，并推出新还款模式以缓解电力行业债务
https://leadership.ng/fg-targets-lower-g.body_zh: 除直接付款外，政府还在考虑用电企欠州政府的矿区权使用费和税款抵扣其未偿债务。政府也正在与国有石油公司尼日利亚国家石油公司有限公司（NNPC Ltd）谈判，以降低供应给发电厂的天然气价格。电力部长约瑟夫·特格贝表示，尼日利亚预计将在2027年前偿清欠付发电企业的债务，目前协商金额的三分之一以上已经结清。部长11月23日在Arise News电视台接受采访时说，政府已向相关企业支付1.23万亿奈拉（8.83亿美元）。政府与发电企业协商的债务总额已从最初估计的6万亿奈拉（43.1亿美元）降至3.3万亿奈拉（23.7亿美元）。政府打算通过多种付款机制相结合的方式结清剩余余额。特格贝称，拟议中的减债办法可从更长期缓解发电企业的运营成本。这些措施针对的是发电企业（GenCos）在2015年2月至2025年3月期间累积的未付账单。根据尼日利亚总统府的说法，总统博拉·蒂努布于2026年4月批准的偿还计划涵盖了这一时期经核实的债务。截至当时，已有15座发电厂签署协议，涵盖其已确认索赔的一部分。为筹集首笔付款，政府称已通过首次债券发行筹集5010亿奈拉（3.6亿美元）。第二次债券发行于9月完成，金额为7290亿奈拉（5.23亿美元）。10月9日，尼日利亚电力大宗交易公司（NBET）宣布，第二轮融资项下的付款已经开始。为补充直接付款，政府正在研究一些安排，以发电企业应付的矿区权使用费抵扣其对州政府的未偿债权。特格贝还提出，就企业所得税采取类似安排的可能性。两种机制目前仍在与相关企业讨论之中。部长表示，采用这类安排后，政府就不必先向发电企业收取资金，再通过偿还债务把钱返还给它们。他还指出，公共资源必须分配给包括教育、医疗卫生和农业在内的多个部门。这些相互竞争预算需求的原因之一，是政府正在探索直接付款以外的替代办法。除了清偿现有欠款，防止新增债务累积仍是一项重大挑战。7月，发电企业协会估计，在偿还计划完成之前，新增欠款可能超过7万亿奈拉（约50.2亿美元）。发电企业首席执行官乔伊·奥加吉表示，向电力市场参与者支付的款项仍不充足。我们占据优势。获取实时报道、独家内幕和独家视角，直接发送到您的手机。不要满足于过时新闻。在WhatsApp上加入LEADERSHIP NEWS，随时随地接收24/7更新 →

https://leadership.ng/tinubus-allies-sta.summary_zh: 法什拉周五接受Arise News独家采访时表示，他主张在2027年大选前支持蒂努布连任。他认为，即使在卸任期间，那些继续追随蒂努布的人仍对他保持忠诚，这使蒂努布有别于其他政治领导人。
https://leadership.ng/tinubus-allies-sta.body: Fashola stated this during an exclusive interview with Arise News on Friday, where he made a case for Tinubu’s re-election ahead of the 2027 general election. The former Lagos State governor, who is currently the All Progressives Congress (APC) Southwest Zonal Coordinator for Stakeholders’ Mobilisation, said Nigerians should assess the ability of presidential candidates to work with others before entrusting them with power. He noted that the three major political figures seeking the nation’s leadership had all emerged from the governorship system, including former Vice President Atiku Abubakar, who was a governor-elect but did not eventually assume office. According to him, the continued loyalty of those who worked with Tinubu, even when he was out of office, distinguishes him from other political leaders. “The three main political candidates today share one trait in common. They all started as governors. One of them didn’t take office, but he was already a governor-elect, Vice President Atiku Abubakar. “Where are all the people who worked with them today? That’s a job reference question. Why is it only President Tinubu that has all those who worked with him, still with him? And they were with him for 16 years or so, out of office when he wasn’t a president. “Very, very good answer to the question. It shows an ability to work with others,” he said. Fashola argued that anyone seeking to govern Nigeria must demonstrate the ability to build and sustain relationships, particularly given the country’s diverse political and cultural composition. He said political leaders should not abandon their parties and associates whenever disagreements or crises arise. “If you are going to get entrusted with managing Nigeria’s diverse family, you must be able to work in a team. And you don’t just get up and jump away when there’s crisis in the fold. “There was crisis in the APC. It didn’t leave the party. The others have left the parties that brought them to prominence. They’ve left the people who work closely with them. “And so people who are going to make this choice must look at the kind of people they want, who are asking them to be entrusted with power,” he added. The former governor further argued that Tinubu’s political coalition had expanded beyond his longstanding associates to include individuals who previously opposed him. According to Fashola, the president’s ability to bring former political adversaries into his camp contributed to the APC’s growing control of state governments. “Now, you know the other interesting part of this story, this angle? All the people who opposed Tinubu when he used to be called the last man standing, all of them are now working with him. “Not just those who worked with him before. Those who opposed him are now working with him. “That’s how he has built a coalition of 30 state governors from one state, from Lagos. And that is profound. “Whether you like him or not, he is able to be trusted with Nigeria’s diversity. Even his opponents, his fiercest foes in political context now work with him. That is a big reference for the job he’s seeking,” Fashola said. His comments come amid opposition allegations that the Tinubu administration is consolidating political power and plotting to establish a one-party state, following the APC’s growing dominance across the country. https://leadership.ng/tinubus-allies-sta.title_zh: 蒂努布的盟友仍与他同行，反对派盟友在哪里？
https://leadership.ng/tinubus-allies-sta.body_zh:
法绍拉周五在接受Arise News独家采访时说了这番话，并为蒂努布在2027年大选前寻求连任进行辩护。这位前拉各斯州州长目前担任进步大会党（APC）西南区利益相关者动员协调员。他说，尼日利亚人应当评估总统候选人与其他人员合作的能力，再把国家权力交托给他们。他指出 Seeking国家领导权的三位主要政治人物都出自州长体系，其中包括前副总统阿蒂库·阿布巴卡尔；阿蒂库当选州长，但最终没有就职。据他所说，即使蒂努布离开公职，与他共事的人仍始终效忠他，这是他区别于其他政治人物之处。“当今三位主要政治候选人有一个共同点。他们都从州长起步。其中一人没有就职，但他已经是当选州长，即副总统阿蒂库·阿布巴卡尔。‘如今，那些曾与他们共事的人都在哪里？这是一项履历查验。为什么只有蒂努布总统身边仍保留着所有曾与他共事的人？他们在非总统任期内，也就是大约16年里一直与他并肩工作。‘这是对这个问题非常好的回答。它体现了与他人合作的能力。’他说。

法绍拉认为，任何寻求治理尼日利亚的人都必须展现建立并维持关系的能力，尤其考虑到该国政治和文化构成多元。他说，政治人物不应在出现分歧或危机时抛弃自己的政党和同僚。“如果你要受托管理尼日利亚这个多元大家庭，就必须能够团队合作。不能一有内部危机就跳走、离开。“进步大会党（APC）曾发生危机。他没有离开该党。其他人却离开了让他们崭露头角的政党，也离开了与他们密切共事的人。“因此，即将作出这一选择的人必须审视自己希望由什么样的人陪伴，以及这些人是否请求将权力交托给他们。”他补充道。

这位前州长还主张，蒂努布的政治联盟已经beyond其长期同事，吸纳了此前反对他的人。法绍拉称，总统把昔日政治对手拉入自己阵营的能力，推动了APC对州政府的控制范围不断扩大。“现在，你了解这个故事中另一个有意思的部分，也就是另一个角度了吗？当年蒂努布还被称为‘最后站着的人’时，所有反对他的人如今都在与他合作。“不只是此前与他共事的人，连反对他的人现在也在与他合作。“这就是他从拉各斯一个州建立起由30位州长组成的联盟的方式。这很了不起。“无论你喜欢他还是不喜欢他，他都有能力让人信任他能够驾驭尼日利亚的多元性。即便是他的对手，他在政治领域中最激烈的敌人，如今也与他合作。这为他正在竞选的职位提供了很有力的履历证明。”法绍拉说。

https://leadership.ng/ransomware-attacks.summary: A new study by cybersecurity firm Kaspersky, in collaboration with research consultancy VDC Strategy, estimated that the global average financial impact of a disruptive ransomware attack could exceed $470,000 per affected company. More than 81,000 users globally encountered ransomware attacks during the third quarter, compared with over 71,000 in the preceding quarter and more than 77,000 in the first quarter.
https://leadership.ng/ransomware-attacks.summary_zh: 网络安全公司Kaspersky与研究咨询机构VDC Strategy合作开展的一项新研究估计，一场破坏性勒索软件攻击给全球受影响企业造成的平均经济损失可能超过$470,000。第三季度，全球有超过81,000名用户遭遇勒索软件攻击，而上一季度超过71,000名，第一季度则超过77,000名。
https://leadership.ng/ransomware-attacks.body: A new study by cybersecurity firm Kaspersky, in collaboration with research consultancy VDC Strategy, estimated that the global average financial impact of a disruptive ransomware attack could exceed $470,000 per affected company. The report, which assessed businesses across manufacturing, retail, healthcare, financial services and professional services, warned that the financial consequences extend beyond ransom payments to include business downtime, lost revenue, information technology recovery, incident response and legal expenses. Europe recorded the highest estimated financial impact at $669,985 per company, followed by the Middle East with $486,497, Asia-Pacific at $439,292, Latin America at $432,321 and the Commonwealth of Independent States (CIS) at $425,969. According to the study, ransom payments could account for approximately 49 per cent of the total financial impact, while the remaining costs arise from business interruption, recovery operations and other expenses required to restore affected systems. The findings highlight the growing economic risks facing companies as they increasingly depend on digital platforms, cloud infrastructure, electronic payment systems and interconnected business applications. Kaspersky’s threat statistics further showed that its security solutions detected 4,470 new ransomware modifications in the third quarter of 2026, representing an increase of approximately 76 per cent from the 2,538 recorded in the second quarter. More than 81,000 users globally encountered ransomware attacks during the third quarter, compared with over 71,000 in the preceding quarter and more than 77,000 in the first quarter. Commenting on the findings, Lead Security Researcher at Kaspersky’s Global Research and Analysis Team, Fabio Assolini, said organisations must look beyond ransom demands when assessing the financial implications of cyberattacks. He said businesses needed to consider the wider costs of operational downtime, recovery and the resources required to restore their systems, adding that proactive protection, effective threat detection and adequate incident-response strategies were essential to reducing exposure. Similarly, Director, Industrial Automation and Sensors at VDC Strategy, Jared Weiner, said putting a financial value on ransomware incidents would help business executives and security professionals understand the risks and make informed investment decisions. The findings are particularly significant for Nigeria, where businesses are accelerating digital transformation across banking, telecommunications, retail, healthcare and public services. A separate cybersecurity assessment by Check Point in February 2026 indicated that Nigerian organisations faced an average of 4,701 cyberattacks weekly, placing the country among Africa’s most targeted markets. For businesses operating in Nigeria, a successful ransomware attack could disrupt payment processing, customer transactions, supply chains and access to critical business records, with consequences for revenue, consumer confidence and service delivery. The Nigerian Data Protection Act 2023, enforced by the Nigeria Data Protection Commission (NDPC), also places obligations on organisations to safeguard personal information and maintain appropriate data protection measures. Consequently, companies facing cyber incidents may have additional regulatory and legal obligations, depending on the nature of the breach and the information affected. To reduce the risks, Kaspersky advised organisations to regularly update software, strengthen endpoint protection, monitor suspicious network activities and maintain offline data backups that cannot be accessed or altered by attackers. It also recommended improved threat intelligence, professional cybersecurity training and effective incident-response arrangements to enable companies to detect attacks early and restore operations quickly. The study further noted that its financial estimates did not include regulatory fines, litigation awards, long-term reputational damage or potential loss of customer trust, suggesting that the actual economic consequences could be higher. https://leadership.ng/ransomware-attacks.title_zh: 勒索软件攻击可能令非洲企业每次损失368,000美元
https://leadership.ng/ransomware-attacks.body_zh: 网络安全公司Kaspersky与研究咨询机构VDC Strategy合作开展的一项新研究估计，破坏性勒索软件攻击给全球企业造成的平均财务影响，每家受影响企业可能超过$470,000。该报告评估了制造业、零售业、医疗保健业、金融服务业和专业服务行业的企业，并警告称，财务后果并不仅限于赎金，还包括业务停摆、收入损失、信息技术恢复、事件响应和法律费用。欧洲录得的预计财务影响最高，每家公司达$669,985；中东为$486,497，亚太地区为$439,292，拉丁美洲为$432,321，独立国家联合体（CIS）为$425,969。研究显示，赎金可能约占财务影响总额的49 per cent，其余成本来自业务中断、恢复作业以及恢复受影响系统所需的其他开支。研究结果凸显了企业日益依赖数字平台、云基础设施、电子支付系统和互联业务应用程序所面临的经济风险不断上升。Kaspersky的威胁统计数据进一步显示，其安全解决方案在2026年第三季度检测到4,470种新的勒索软件变种，较第二季度记录的2,538种增加约76 per cent。第三季度全球有超过81,000名用户遭遇勒索软件攻击，而上一季度超过71,000人，第一季度则超过77,000人。Kaspersky全球研究与分析团队首席安全研究员Fabio Assolini在评论研究结果时表示，各组织在评估网络攻击的财务影响时，不能只考虑赎金要求。他说，企业需要考虑运营停摆、恢复工作以及恢复系统所需资源等更广泛成本，并补充称，主动防护、有效的威胁检测和充分的事件响应策略对于降低风险敞口至关重要。同样，VDC Strategy工业自动化与传感器总监Jared Weiner表示，对勒索软件事件进行财务量化，将有助于企业高管和安全专业人员了解风险，并作出明智的投资决策。这些研究结果对尼日利亚尤其具有重要意义，因为当地企业正在加快银行、电信、零售、医疗保健和公共服务等领域的数字化转型。Check Point于2026年2月进行的另一项网络安全评估显示，尼日利亚组织平均每周遭遇4,701次网络攻击，使该国成为非洲遭攻击最多的市场之一。对于在尼日利亚经营的企业而言，一次成功的勒索软件攻击可能扰乱支付处理、客户交易、供应链以及关键业务记录的访问，并对收入、消费者信心和服务交付造成影响。《尼日利亚数据保护法2023》由尼日利亚数据保护委员会（NDPC）执行，该法也要求各组织保护个人信息，并采取适当的数据保护措施。因此，面临网络安全事件的企业可能还需承担额外的监管和法律义务，具体取决于违规行为的性质和所涉及的信息。为降低风险，Kaspersky建议各组织定期更新软件、加强端点防护、监控可疑网络活动，并维护攻击者无法访问或篡改的离线数据备份。它还建议加强威胁情报、推进专业网络安全培训并建立有效的事件响应机制，使企业能够尽早发现攻击并迅速恢复运营。该研究还指出，其财务估算未计入监管罚款、诉讼裁决、长期声誉损害或潜在客户信任流失，这意味着实际经济后果可能更高。我们掌握独家优势。获取实时报道、独家新闻和深入视角，直接推送到您的手机。不要满足于过时新闻。加入LEADERSHIP NEWS的WhatsApp，随时随地获取全天候更新 →

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.title: Chinese envoy warns US-Korea alliance shouldn't become 'tool' against China
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.summary: Dai rejects trilateral summit characterized as 'Yalta 2.0' Chinese Ambassador to Korea Dai Bing said Thursday that the Korea-United States alliance should not become a constraint on bilateral relations between Seoul and Beijing, voicing concerns over Washington's push to modernize the alliance and expand the strategic flexibility of U.S. Forces Korea (USFK).
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.summary_zh: 戴 Dai 拒绝参加被称为“雅尔塔2.0”的三方峰会。中国驻韩国大使戴秉钢周四表示，韩美同盟不应成为首尔与北京双边关系的制约因素，并对华盛顿推动实现同盟现代化以及扩大驻韩美军的战略灵活性表达关切。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body: Dai rejects trilateral summit characterized as 'Yalta 2.0' Chinese Ambassador to Korea Dai Bing said Thursday that the Korea-United States alliance should not become a constraint on bilateral relations between Seoul and Beijing, voicing concerns over Washington's push to modernize the alliance and expand the strategic flexibility of U.S. Forces Korea (USFK). "Any country should maintain its autonomy. We respect the Korea-U.S. alliance, which has a long history," Dai said at a press conference in central Seoul, a week after China hosted the 2026 Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summit in Shenzhen. He said China never asked Korea to choose between Washington and Beijing, adding that he believed Seoul has the wisdom to develop relations with both. However, he questioned the implications of Washington's push to modernize the Korea-U.S. alliance and expand its strategic role. "Terms such as 'modernization of the Korea-U.S. alliance' and 'strategic flexibility' carry, to some extent, an implication of targeting China," the ambassador said. Dai also said Beijing had reason for concern, citing recent remarks by a U.S. official in Korea. He did not name the official, but his comments appeared to refer to USFK Commander Gen. Xavier Brunson, who in May described Korea as "the dagger in the heart of Asia" when viewed from China's east coast. The remark prompted the Chinese Embassy in Seoul to say Brunson had "crossed the line." "We do not want the Korea-U.S. alliance to turn into a tool for dealing with China," Dai said. "We hope the Korean side will maintain its strategic autonomy and manage its relations with both the U.S. and China well." Regarding the tension on the Korean Peninsula, Dai said President Lee Jae Myung and Chinese President Xi Jinping exchanged views on the issue during their meeting on the sidelines of the APEC summit. He said Lee had called for China to play a more active role in addressing issues on the peninsula, while Xi explained recent developments in exchanges between Beijing and Pyongyang. "China will maintain continuity and stability in its policy toward the Korean Peninsula and continue to play an active and constructive role in its own way," Dai said. "Peace and stability on the Peninsula serve the common interests of both Korea and China. We will continue to contribute to peace and stability." The ambassador was also asked about China's response to Pyongyang's advancing nuclear capabilities. Dai reiterated Beijing's commitment to the global nonproliferation regime but did not directly address Pyongyang's weapons program. "As a permanent member of the U.N. Security Council, China takes the nuclear issue seriously and maintains a firm position. We remain committed to upholding the authority, continuity and integrity of the Nuclear Nonproliferation Treaty," he said. Dai described the first-ever trilateral summit among the leaders of China, the U.S. and Russia on Nov. 19 as a "landmark meeting with historical significance." He said the meeting took place in a sincere and friendly atmosphere with the three leaders reaching a series of agreements and issuing a peace declaration. They also exchanged views on the war in Ukraine and issues concerning the Korean Peninsula and the Middle East, according to Dai. Dai, meanwhile, rejected characterizations of the meeting as "Yalta 2.0" or the establishment of a new "Group of Three" world order. "I do not agree with such assessments. This was, in essence, a peace summit," he said. He drew a contrast with the 1945 Yalta Conference, arguing that it had been marked by the hegemonic politics of major powers, with both China and Korea among the countries that suffered as a result. "China advocates multilateralism in its foreign policy. International issues should be addressed through consultation among all countries, and we oppose monopolization by a small number of nations," he said. Acknowledging that a single meeting could not resolve all issues, he said the summit had planted a seed for future progress. "As President Xi emphasized, this meeting planted a seed. That seed will eventually sprout, blossom and bear fruit," he said. On the Trump administration's Section 301 trade actions over alleged industrial overcapacity in 16 economies, including China and Korea, Dai said there would be no winner in a tariff war. "We all know that there are no winners in a tariff war. China is firmly opposed to the U.S. policy and will continue to engage in negotiations with Washington to reach an agreement," he said. Yet, Dai expressed optimism about China-U.S. ties, noting that Xi is highly likely to visit the U.S. next month at Trump's invitation to attend the Group of 20 summit. "I believe that the principles of mutual respect, fairness and reciprocity between China and the U.S. remain in place, and that a constructive and strategically stable relationship is gradually taking shape," he said

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/t.body: The Korea Tourism Organization (KTO) and the United States Forces Korea (USFK) are strengthening ties through a new partnership aimed at expanding cultural exchange and promoting regional tourism across Korea. The KTO said Friday that it had signed a memorandum of understanding with the ROK-US Combined Forces Command to promote tourism and cultural exchange as part of efforts to deepen friendship between the two countries. Building on the success of joint tourism and cultural experience programs conducted this year, the agreement aims to provide U.S. and Korean military personnel and their families with more opportunities to explore Korean culture while encouraging visits to destinations beyond major cities. Under the agreement, which runs through Dec. 31, 2027, the two organizations will collaborate to develop region-specific tourism experiences, support security, history and cultural tours for military personnel and their families, organize joint tourism and cultural exchange initiatives, and promote programs through their respective resources and networks. The partnership follows a series of successful programs held between September and November this year, which introduced approximately 920 USFK service members and family members to various aspects of Korean tourism. At Jeonju Nambu Market, selected as one of the 2026 K-Tourism Markets, participants sampled regional specialties, shopped for local ingredients and experienced everyday Korean life firsthand. The program also included a visit to HiKR Ground, the KTO's tourism promotion center in Jung District, central Seoul, where participants explored Korean pop culture and contemporary K-culture experiences. Another highlight was the DMZ (Demilitarized Zone) Live Experience Center in Paju, offering visitors an opportunity to learn more about Korea's history and security landscape. Looking ahead, the KTO plans to expand its range of regional experiences in 2027, combining traditional markets with distinctive local history, cultural heritage and culinary attractions. “Through this partnership, we hope U.S. and Korean service members and their families will discover Korea’s hidden gems. Next year, we plan to offer even richer regional experiences that bring together traditional markets, local history, cultural heritage and culinary attractions,” said Kang Yu-young, head of the KTO's Regional Tourism Development Team. The initiative reflects a broader effort to use cultural exchange as a bridge between communities while directing international visitors toward regional destinations, supporting local businesses and creating new opportunities for tourism growth across the country. Unlock these with Subscription The rupee plunged 24 paise to 92.62 against the U.S. dollar in early trade on Friday (November 27, 2026), dragged down by a recovery in crude oil prices and subdued sentiment in domestic equity markets. Sustained inflow of foreign funds and a softening dollar capped the fall in the Indian currency, forex traders said. In the interbank foreign exchange market, the rupee opened at 92.44 and declined to 92.62 against the greenback, trading 24 paise lower from its previous close. On Thursday, the rupee settled down 18 paise to 92.38 against the US dollar, a day after jumping 65 paise to reach its highest level this fiscal year so far. The Indian currency became the best-performing Asian currency, recovering nearly 5 per cent from its lowest-ever close of 96.88 against the US dollar recorded on October 8. Meanwhile, the dollar index, which gauges the greenback's strength against a basket of six currencies, was at 103.65, lower by 0.07 per cent. Brent crude, the global oil benchmark, was trading 0.11 per cent lower at USD 96.46 per barrel in futures trade. Analysts said that oil prices breached the USD 95-a-barrel level after reports of vessels being targeted in the Strait of Hormuz, fuelling concerns over supply-chain disruptions. In the domestic equity market, Sensex fell 350.25 points or 0.42 per cent to 83,978.34, while the Nifty was down 79.05 points or 0.31 per cent to 25,807.25. Foreign institutional investors (FIIs) bought equities worth Rs 5,843.33 crore on a net basis on Thursday, according to exchange data. Unlock these with Subscription The latest U.S. tariffs on India are nothing more than a pressure tactic to push for the signing of a trade deal. The U.S. Trade Representative (USTR) has proposed to levy a tariff of 25% for India’s apparent use of strategic excess manufacturing capacity to the detriment of American industry. This is the second-highest tariff rate the USTR has applied across the 14 countries that it has taken action against. The pressure on India does not come from the 25% rate but from the 17% this could be reduced to if it signs a trade deal with the U.S. This latest action is yet another example of how, despite the frothiness of India-U.S. trade relations over the past year and a half, the actual substance has not changed. The 25% rate now proposed, which is net of existing tariffs, is nearly the same as the 26% rate that U.S. President Donald Trump had first announced when he unveiled his ‘Liberation Day’ reciprocal tariffs in April 2025. Indeed, it is exactly the same as the 25% tariff he finally imposed in July 2025, before he imposed an additional 25% for India’s Russian oil imports. The 17% rate is also only marginally lower than the 18% that the two countries had agreed on in their joint statement in February 2026. It is also just one percentage point lower than the tariffs on competitors such as Indonesia and Malaysia. The allegation of India having excess capacity does not hold water. Indeed, were India to have excess manufacturing capacity in any sector, it would be the Government of India that would be the first to announce it with great fanfare, instead of denying it as it did. After all, that has been its aim since 2014. Yet, even a basic assessment of India’s import dependence and the fact that manufacturing’s share in GDP is lower now than a decade ago shows that India is far from having excess manufacturing capacity in any sector. Further, higher tariffs are unlikely to reduce America’s imports of the goods from India that it does depend on. The USTR mentioned generic pharmaceuticals, telecommunication equipment, and renewable energy goods. The first two are items that India has developed expertise in, which is distinct from strategic excess capacity. A relatively small tariff disadvantage will not substantially erode the attractiveness of these Indian products. Renewable energy imports from India have swelled because the U.S. is reducing its purchases from China. Hanging over all of this are the 100% tariffs related to the purchase of Russian oil, which have only temporarily been paused. India has so far held off on signing a deal, and must go ahead with one only if it is convinced that the benefits at least equal the costs. Comments have to be in English, and in full sentences. https://www.thehindu.com/opinion/editori.body_zh: 订阅账户还可享受《 premium stories 》、社论、观点等更多内容。订阅即可解锁这些内容。美国针对印度的最新关税不过是施压手段，意在推动印度签署贸易协议。美国贸易代表办公室（USTR）提议对印度征收25%的关税，理由是印度似乎利用战略性过剩制造能力损害了美国工业。这是USTR对采取行动的14个国家中实施的第二高关税税率。印度面临的压力并非来自25%的税率，而来自如果印度与美国签署贸易协议，这一税率可降至17%。最新行动再次表明，尽管过去一年半印美贸易关系表面上热闹喧嚣，但实际情况并未改变。如今提议的25%税率是在现有关税基础上净额计算，几乎与美国总统唐纳德·特朗普于2025年4月公布“解放日”互惠关税时最初宣布的26%税率相同。事实上，它与他最终于2025年7月实施的25%关税完全一致；此后，他又因印度进口俄罗斯石油加征了25%的关税。17%的税率也仅略低于两国在2026年2月联合声明中商定的18%。它也只比印度尼西亚和马来西亚等竞争对手所面临的关税低一个百分点。关于印度存在过剩产能的指控并不成立。事实上，如果印度任何行业存在过剩制造能力，那也会是印度政府率先大张旗鼓地宣布，而非像现在这样予以否认。毕竟，自2014年以来，这一直是印度政府的目标。然而，即便只是对印度进口依赖程度以及制造业占国内生产总值比重如今低于十年前这一事实进行基本评估，也足以表明印度远不存在任何行业的过剩制造能力。此外，提高关税不太可能减少美国从印度进口其依赖商品的数量。USTR提到了仿制药、电信设备和可再生能源产品。前两类是印度已经形成专长的产品，这与战略性过剩产能不同。相对较小的关税劣势不会实质性削弱这些印度产品的吸引力。由于美国正减少从中国采购可再生能源产品，来自印度的可再生能源进口有所增加。悬在这一切之上的，是与购买俄罗斯石油有关的100%关税，目前只是暂时暂停。迄今印度一直拒绝签署协议，只有确信收益至少等同于成本时，才会推进签署。评论必须使用英语，并以完整句子表述。评论不得含有辱骂性或人身攻击内容。请遵守我们的社区评论准则。我们已迁移至新的评论平台。如果你已经是《The Hindu》的注册用户并已登录，可以继续参与我们文章的讨论。如果你没有账户，请注册并登录后发表评论。用户可以登录自己的Vuukle账户查看以前的评论

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/head.summary_zh: 一名警方调查员星期四向联邦首都领地高等法院表示，尼日利亚中央银行（CBN）前行长戈德温·埃梅菲埃并未采用前总统穆罕马杜·布哈里批准的重新设计方案，而是对尼日利亚纸币进行了颜色调整。证人告诉法庭，调查人员未发现尼日利亚中央银行董事会开会批准颜色调整的证据。他说，埃梅菲埃先生曾就尼日利亚货币重新设计征求布哈里总统的批准，并附上拟发行纸币的样品，总统批准了该方案。
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/head.body: A police investigator on Thursday told an FCT High Court that former Central Bank of Nigeria (CBN) Governor Godwin Emefiele produced a colour swap of the naira notes instead of the redesign approved by former President Muhammadu Buhari. Eloho Okpoziakpo, the 11th prosecution witness, said this while testifying in Mr Emefiele’s trial over allegations of illegal redesign of the naira and other financial misconduct. Mr Okpoziakpo, a Commissioner of Police who led investigations into allegations against the former CBN governor following his removal from office in June 2023, gave the testimony while being led in evidence by the Director of Public Prosecutions of the Federation, Rotimi Oyedepo, a Senior Advocate of Nigeria (SAN). The witness told the court that investigators found no evidence that the CBN board met and approved the colour swap. He said Mr Emefiele had sought President Buhari’s approval for a naira redesign and attached samples of the proposed notes, which the president approved. “But what was eventually done was not a redesign as was approved by the president but a colour swap,” Mr Okpoziakpo said. The case is one of several prosecutions Mr Emefiele has faced since his removal from office in June 2023 over allegations of corruption and financial misconduct. In the four charges filed against him in this case, the Economic and Financial Crimes Commission (EFCC) accused him of unlawfully redesigning the naira notes and printing currency worth N684.5 billion at a cost of N18.96 billion. The EFCC accused Mr Emefiele of illegally redesigning Nigeria’s three highest denominations, the N200, N500 and N1,000 notes, in 2022. The policy triggered a severe cash shortage, causing widespread hardship and disruption in the build-up to the 2023 general elections. According to the EFCC, Mr Emefiele violated Section 19 of the CBN Act, which requires the bank to obtain the president’s approval, based on the recommendation of its board, before changing the currency. The commission also accused him of unlawfully approving the withdrawal of N124.8 billion from the Consolidated Revenue Fund (CRF), allegedly in violation of the requirement that withdrawals from the account must follow procedures prescribed by the National Assembly, usually through an Appropriation Act or budget. At Thursday’s proceedings, Mr Okpoziakpo said Mr Emefiele forwarded the president’s approval to the Managing Director of the Nigerian Security Printing and Minting Plc (NSPM). The managing director, however, raised concerns in a letter to Mr Emefiele, which the witness read to the court. “It was then agreed that based on the urgency, we should advise the CBN to avoid changes to the banknotes, which require a long period to implement. Instead, work on the colours because of the availability of inks and how far it can be accessed. It will also enable the NSPM to serve the CBN and its nation diligently,” part of the letter read. Mr Okpoziakpo said the initial designs submitted by Mr Emefiele to the president included QR codes, watermarks and different numbering on the N1,000, N500 and N200 notes. However, he said the versions Mr Emefiele eventually approved for production did not have QR codes. The witness insisted that there was no subsequent presidential approval for the notes that were eventually produced. The investigator also told the court that Mr Emefiele approved the withdrawal of N124.8 billion from the CRF without appropriation by the National Assembly. The CRF, established under the Nigerian Constitution, is the federal government’s central account into which most government revenues are paid and from which public expenditure is made with legislative approval. He said the Ministry of Finance informed the investigation team in a letter that the debit was made directly by the CBN. During cross-examination by Mr Emefiele’s lawyer, Olalekan Ojo, Mr Okpoziakpo listed his academic and professional qualifications. He said he holds a Bachelor of Science degree in psychology, a Master of Science degree in International Diplomacy and has undergone basic police training. The witness said he had served in the Nigeria Police Force for 31 years, spending most of his career in investigations. He said he worked at the police intelligence department in Abuja during the implementation of the naira redesign policy. He also told the court that he took Mr Emefiele’s statement at the Kuje Custodial Centre alongside Jim Obazee, the special investigator who led the investigation into the former CBN governor’s alleged misconduct. However, Mr Okpoziakpo said he did not personally interview Mr Emefiele. He said his role involved analysing documents and interviewing the managing director of the NSPM. Mr Ojo presented him with an audit report of the CBN covering Mr Emefiele’s tenure. But the witness maintained that the investigation was not based on the audit report but focused on the legality of the withdrawal from the CRF. Mr Okpoziakpo’s testimony is consistent with that of Ali Muhammed, the 10th prosecution witness. On 6 October, Mr Muhammed told the court that withdrawals from the CRF required the approval of the Ministry of Finance and the Office of the Accountant-General of the Federation (OAGF). Mr Muhammed said the Federal Ministry of Finance was unaware of the N124.8 billion deduction. The EFCC has so far called 11 prosecution witnesses, including Mr Okpoziakpo. Several of them have testified that the naira redesign and other financial transactions carried out under Mr Emefiele lacked the required approvals from relevant authorities. In November 2024, the fifth prosecution witness, Kingsley Obiorah, a former CBN deputy governor, told the court that the bank’s board never recommended the naira redesign to former President Buhari. Mr Obiorah, who testified virtually, said he had previously served as Mr Emefiele’s special adviser on economic matters before his appointment as deputy governor. He said the CBN board first learnt of the redesign policy in mid-December 2022. Similarly, Chinedu Eneaya testified in October 2025 that Mr Emefiele embarked on the controversial redesign in 2022 without obtaining approval from the CBN board and its Committee of Governors (COG). He said Mr Emefiele only sought the approval of the board and COG after Mr Buhari had consented to the redesign. According to Mr Eneaya, Mr Emefiele admitted this in an extrajudicial statement he made during the investigation. Between late 2022 and early 2023, the CBN implemented the redesign policy, withdrawing the legal tender status of the old N200, N500 and N1,000 notes. The bank continued with the policy despite the shortage of the new notes in circulation. This triggered widespread hardship and disruption across the country, prompting some state governors to approach the Supreme Court for intervention. Mr Buhari defended the policy even after the Supreme Court issued an interim order suspending its implementation in 2023. The dispute was eventually resolved on 3 March 2023, when the Supreme Court delivered its final judgement, reversing the policy and prompting Mr Buhari to change course

高等法院表示，尼日利亚中央银行（CBN）前行长戈德温·埃梅菲耶并未按照前总统穆罕马杜·布哈里批准的方案重新设计奈拉纸币，而是对纸币进行了颜色替换。第11名控方证人埃洛霍·奥克波齐亚克波在就埃梅菲耶先生涉嫌非法重新设计奈拉及其他财务不当行为受审一案作证时这样说。奥克波齐亚克波先生是一名警察专员。2023年6月埃梅菲耶先生被免职后，他负责调查针对这位前尼日利亚中央银行行长的指控。作证时，由尼日利亚联邦公共检察官主任罗蒂米·奥耶德波引导，他是一名尼日利亚高级大律师（SAN）。证人对法院说，调查人员没有发现证据表明尼日利亚中央银行董事会曾开会批准更换纸币颜色。他说，埃梅菲耶先生曾寻求布哈里总统批准重新设计奈拉，并附上拟发行纸币的样品，总统批准了这些样品。“但最终实施的并不是总统批准的重新设计，而是颜色替换。”奥克波齐亚克波先生说。自2023年6月因涉嫌腐败和财务不当行为被免职以来，针对埃梅菲耶先生的案件有多起指控。本案共有四项罪名，经济和金融犯罪委员会（EFCC）指控他非法重新设计奈拉纸币，并以189.6亿奈拉的成本印刷了价值6845亿奈拉的货币。经济和金融犯罪委员会指控埃梅菲耶先生于2022年非法重新设计尼日利亚面额最高的三种纸币，即200奈拉、500奈拉和1,000奈拉纸币。这项政策引发了严重的现金短缺，在2023年大选筹备期间造成大范围困难和混乱。据经济和金融犯罪委员会称，埃梅菲耶先生违反了《尼日利亚中央银行法》第19条。该条要求银行在根据董事会建议变更货币之前，必须获得总统批准。委员会还指控他非法批准从联邦综合收入基金（CRF）提取1248亿奈拉，违反了从该账户提款必须遵循国民议会规定程序的要求；此类提款通常须通过拨款法或预算进行。周四庭审时，奥克波齐亚克波先生说，埃梅菲耶先生将总统的批准文件转交给尼日利亚安全印钞与造币公司（NSPM）董事总经理。不过，该董事总经理在致埃梅菲耶先生的一封信中提出了担忧，证人在法庭上宣读了信函内容。信中部分内容称：“鉴于时间紧迫，我们当时商定，应建议尼日利亚中央银行避免对需要较长实施周期的纸币进行变更，而应着手调整颜色，因为这取决于油墨的供应情况以及能够采购到油墨的程度。这样也能让尼日利亚安全印钞与造币公司勤勉地为尼日利亚中央银行及其国家提供服务。”奥克波齐亚克波先生说，埃梅菲耶先生最初提交给总统的设计方案包括在1,000奈拉、500奈拉和200奈拉纸币上加入二维码、水印和不同的编号。然而，他说，埃梅菲耶先生最终批准投产的版本没有二维码。证人坚称，后来实际发行的纸币并未获得事后的总统批准。调查员还告诉法院，埃梅菲耶先生在未经国民议会拨款的情况下，批准从联邦综合收入基金提取1248亿奈拉。联邦综合收入基金依据《尼日利亚宪法》设立，是联邦政府的中央账户，大部分政府收入缴入该账户，公共支出也在获得立法批准后从中支付。他说，财政部的信函告知调查小组，这笔款项是由尼日利亚中央银行直接扣划的。在埃梅菲耶先生的律师奥拉莱坎·奥乔交叉询问时，奥克波齐亚克波先生列举了自己的学历和专业资历。他说，他拥有心理学理学学士学位、国际外交理学硕士学位，并接受过基本警务培训。证人称，他已在尼日利亚警察部队服役31年职业生涯中的大部分时间从事调查工作。他说，在实施奈拉重新设计政策期间，他曾在阿布贾警察情报部门工作。他还告诉法院，他与负责调查这位前尼日利亚中央银行行长涉嫌不当行为的特别调查员吉姆·奥巴齐，在库杰羁押中心录取了埃梅菲耶先生的陈述。不过，奥克波齐亚克波先生说，他本人并未讯问埃梅菲耶先生。他说自己的工作包括分析文件和讯问尼日利亚安全印钞与造币公司董事总经理。奥乔先生向他出示了一份涵盖埃梅菲耶先生任期的尼日利亚中央银行审计报告。但证人坚持称，调查并非以审计报告为依据，而是着重核查从联邦综合收入基金提款是否合法。奥克波齐亚克波先生的证词与第10名控方证人阿里·穆罕默德的证词一致。10月6日，穆罕默德先生告诉法院，从联邦综合收入基金提款需要得到财政部和联邦总审计长办公室（OAGF）的批准。穆罕默德先生说，联邦财政部并不知道扣除这1248亿奈拉一事。经济和金融犯罪委员会迄今已传唤11名控方证人，其中包括奥克波齐亚克波先生。其中数人作证称，奈拉重新设计以及埃梅菲耶先生任内实施的其他财务交易，均未获得相关机构所需批准。2024年11月，第5名控方证人、前尼日利亚中央银行副行长金斯利·奥比奥拉告诉法院，该银行董事会从未向布哈里前总统建议重新设计奈拉。奥比奥拉先生通过视频作证。他此前曾任埃梅菲耶先生的经济事务特别顾问，之后获任副行长。他说，尼日利亚中央银行董事会直到2022年12月中旬才首次得知这项重新设计政策。类似地，奇内杜·埃内阿亚于2025年10月作证称，埃梅菲耶先生在未获尼日利亚中央银行董事会及其行长委员会（COG）批准的情况下，于2022年启动了这项备受争议的重新设计。他说，在布哈里先生同意重新设计后，埃梅菲耶先生才寻求董事会和行长委员会的批准。据埃内阿亚先生称，埃梅菲耶先生在调查期间作出的非司法陈述中承认了这一点。2022年末至2023年初，尼日利亚中央银行实施了重新设计政策，取消了旧版200奈拉、500奈拉和1,000奈拉纸币的法定流通地位。尽管新纸币流通量不足，该银行仍继续推行这项政策。这在全国引发大范围困难和混乱，促使一些州长向最高法院申请干预。即使最高法院于2023年下达暂停实施该政策的临时命令，布哈里先生仍为这项政策辩护。争议最终于2023年3月3日得到解决。当时，最高法院作出最终判决，推翻了这项政策，促使布哈里先生改变立场

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title: Lee touts new deposit system as effective in curbing illegal fishing by Chinese vessels
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary: President Lee Jae Myung on Thursday touted a tightened deposit system introduced by the Coast Guard, saying it has been significantly effective in curbing illegal fishing by Chinese vessels.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary_zh: 李在明总统周四赞扬海岸警卫队推出的收紧存款制度，称该制度在遏制中国船只非法捕捞方面成效显著。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: President Lee Jae Myung on Thursday touted a tightened deposit system introduced by the Coast Guard, saying it has been significantly effective in curbing illegal fishing by Chinese vessels. Lee made the remarks in a post on his X account, sharing a news report that an increasing number of Chinese fishermen have given up their boats and abandoned illegal operations due to the financial burden since the Coast Guard began requiring deposits of up to 1.5 billion won ($1.1 million) in May from Chinese vessels caught fishing illegally. The Coast Guard requires the deposits in exchange for the release of Chinese vessels caught fishing illegally and their crew members. Previously, the maximum deposit was capped at 300 million won. Illegal Chinese fishing has increased in South Korea's exclusive economic zone in recent years, with the Coast Guard seizing 57 illegal Chinese fishing vessels last year
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title_zh: 李明博称新登陆制度有助于遏制中国船只非法捕鱼
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 李在明总统周四称赞韩国海岸警卫队推出的强化保证金制度，称该制度在遏制中国船只非法捕捞方面成效显著。李在明当天在X账号发文，转发了一篇新闻报道。自海岸警卫队5月起要求被查获非法捕捞的中国船只缴纳最高15亿韩元（110万美元）保证金以来，因经济负担加重，越来越多中国渔民被迫放弃船只并停止非法捕捞。海岸警卫队要求中国船只缴纳保证金后，才会释放因非法捕捞被查获的船只及其船员。此前，保证金上限为3亿韩元。近年来，韩国专属经济区内的中国非法捕捞活动不断增加，海岸警卫队去年查获了57艘非法捕捞的中国船只。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.title: Real household income falls despite chip export boom
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.summary: Income gap widens as earnings from work fall 9.2% for lowest-income households Real household income in Korea fell for the first time in 10 quarters in the third quarter, according to data released Thursday by the Ministry of Data and Statistics. Adjusted for inflation, however, it fell 2.1 percent, the first decline since the first quarter of 2024, when real household income fell 1.6 percent.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.summary_zh: 随着劳动收入下降9.2%，最低收入家庭收入差距扩大。根据数据与统计部周四发布的数据，韩国实际家庭收入第三季度出现10个季度以来首次下降。不过，经通胀因素调整后，实际家庭收入下降2.1%，这是自2024年第一季度以来的首次下滑，当时实际家庭收入下降1.6%。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.body: Income gap widens as earnings from work fall 9.2% for lowest-income households Real household income in Korea fell for the first time in 10 quarters in the third quarter, according to data released Thursday by the Ministry of Data and Statistics. The decline came even as the economy grew 3.4 percent in the quarter, buoyed by a semiconductor boom, and was expected to expand in the high 3 percent range this year. The benefits of economic growth were uneven across households. Lower-income families earned less from work and received less in transfers while facing higher interest payments, further widening the income gap. Average monthly household income rose 0.8 percent from a year earlier to 5.48 million won ($4,080), the data showed. Adjusted for inflation, however, it fell 2.1 percent, the first decline since the first quarter of 2024, when real household income fell 1.6 percent. The decline stands in contrast to the rise in real gross domestic product (GDP), which grew 3.4 percent over the same period. Disposable income, what households have left to spend or save after taxes and other non-consumption expenses, also fell across all income quintiles, with the monthly average dropping 1.7 percent from a year earlier to 4.3 million won. The decline came as non-consumption expenses, including interest payments, taxes and transfers to other households, climbed 11 percent, while household income rose 0.8 percent. With the Bank of Korea raising its benchmark rate by a quarter of a percentage point to 3.25 percent on Thursday, debt-servicing costs are likely to put further pressure on household budgets. The figures highlight the gap between the country’s headline growth and the incomes of small businesses, self-employed workers and households. Growth driven by exports and investment has yet to translate into higher household incomes and greater spending power. Finance Minister Lee Hyoung-il acknowledged the uneven recovery at a press briefing on Monday. warning that the semiconductor sector’s growing weight in the economy could “widen the gap between industries and leave the country more exposed to external shocks.” “People’s livelihoods are not improving as quickly as the economy is recovering,” he said. The divide was especially stark between the top and bottom 20 percent of households by income, with the gap between the two groups widening. Average monthly income among the bottom 20 percent fell 2.7 percent from a year earlier to 1.28 million won, making it the only income group to see a decline. By contrast, average monthly income among households in the top 20 percent rose 1.4 percent to 11.7 million won. Despite an overall rise in household earnings from work, monthly earned income for the bottom 20 percent fell 9.2 percent year-on-year to 248,000 won. The top 20 percent saw their earned income rise 4.9 percent to 8.33 million won a month. Households in the bottom 20 percent also continued to run a deficit, with monthly outlays exceeding disposable income by an average of 344,000 won. Their deficit widened by 32.1 percent from a year earlier. Park Soon-ok, who is in charge of household income and expenditure statistics at the ministry, attributed the drop in income among the lowest-income households in part to a change in the group’s composition. “The share of wage-earning households in the bottom income group fell significantly, while that of households without employed members increased,” she said
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.title_zh: 尽管芯片出口繁荣，实际家庭收入仍下降
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.body_zh: 最低收入家庭劳动所得下降9.2%，收入差距扩大。韩国数据与统计部周四发布的数据显示，第三季度韩国家庭实际收入10个季度以来首次下降。尽管半导体产业繁荣推动经济在该季度增长3.4%，且预计今年经济增速将处于3%高位区间，经济增长带来的利益在各家庭之间却分布不均。低收入家庭劳动所得减少，领取的转移支付也减少，同时还要面对更高的利息支出，进一步扩大了收入差距。数据显示，家庭月均收入同比上涨0.8%，达到548万韩元（$4,080）。但经通胀因素调整后，实际收入下降2.1%，这是自2024年第一季度以来首次下降；当时实际家庭收入降幅为1.6%。实际家庭收入的下降与实际国内生产总值（GDP）的增长形成鲜明对比，后者同期增长3.4%。可支配收入，即家庭缴纳税款和支付其他非消费支出后剩余、可用于消费或储蓄的收入，也across all income quintiles出现下降，月均值同比减少1.7%，降至430万韩元。非消费支出，包括利息支出、税款以及对其他家庭的转移支付，增长了11%，而家庭收入仅增长0.8%。韩国央行周四将基准利率上调0.25个百分点至3.25%，偿债成本可能进一步挤压家庭预算。这些数字凸显了该国整体经济增长与小企业、个体经营者及家庭收入之间的差距。由出口和投资拉动的增长尚未转化为更高的家庭收入和更强的消费能力。财政部长李炯烈周一在新闻发布会上承认复苏不均衡，并警告称，半导体行业在经济中的权重不断上升，可能“扩大行业间的差距，并使国家更容易受到外部冲击”。他说：“随着经济复苏，民生改善的速度并没有同样快。”按收入划分，位居最高和最低20%的家庭之间差距尤其明显，两组之间的鸿沟进一步扩大。最低20%家庭的月均收入同比下降2.7%，降至128万韩元，成为唯一收入下降的群体。相比之下，最高20%家庭的月均收入增长1.4%，达到1170万韩元。尽管家庭劳动所得总体上升，最低20%家庭的月劳动所得仍同比下降9.2%，降至24.8万韩元。最高20%家庭的月劳动所得增长4.9%，达到833万韩元。最低20%家庭也继续出现赤字，月均支出比可支配收入高出34.4万韩元，赤字较上年同期扩大32.1%。该部负责家庭收入和支出统计工作的朴顺玉将最低收入家庭收入下降部分归因于该群体构成的变化。她说：“最低收入组中，有工资收入家庭的占比大幅下降，而没有就业成员家庭的占比则上升。”

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/oth.title: Korea challenges US claims of state-led overcapacity
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/oth.summary: Korea is pushing back against Washington's claim that its industrial policies are contributing to structural excess capacity in manufacturing, as a new U.S. tariff investigation raises concerns over whether support for domestic semiconductor production could face further trade pressure.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/oth.summary_zh: 韩国正反驳华盛顿的说法，即韩国的产业政策正在加剧制造业结构性产能过剩。随着美国启动新的关税调查，支持韩国国内半导体生产是否会面临进一步贸易压力的问题引发关注。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/oth.body: Korea is pushing back against Washington's claim that its industrial policies are contributing to structural excess capacity in manufacturing, as a new U.S. tariff investigation raises concerns over whether support for domestic semiconductor production could face further trade pressure. The Ministry of Trade, Industry and Resources said Thursday that it disagrees with much of the evidence cited by the U.S. Trade Representative (USTR), arguing that Korea's industrial policies are driven by market demand and companies' investment decisions rather than government efforts to expand production beyond actual demand. It emphasized that it would seek to preserve the 15 percent tariff ceiling agreed under last year’s bilateral trade deal. “There are substantial parts of the report cited by the USTR that we cannot agree with. Korea’s industrial policies are based on a market economy and driven by companies’ investment demand. Government support is focused on strengthening companies’ core capabilities and building broader infrastructure. Our position is that this cannot be viewed as structural oversupply led by the state,” a ministry official said during a briefing. “There are also aspects of the U.S. argument that we believe lack a sound logical basis or are not well-founded, and we will actively convey our position on these points to the U.S. side.” The ministry's response came after the USTR announced Wednesday (local time) that it had found 14 economies, including Korea, engaged in practices contributing to excess manufacturing capacity and proposed additional tariffs under its trade law, Section 301. USTR Jamieson Greer specifically criticized Korea's government support and infrastructure plans, arguing they would expand overseas supply without generating corresponding demand. "These are the types of things that are not responding to actual demand. They are government interventions and they are increasing supply overseas without actually increasing consumption overseas," Greer said in an interview with CNBC following the announcement. The USTR's investigation report cited Korea's planned semiconductor cluster in the Jeonnam-Gwangju Special Metropolitan City region as an example of government-backed efforts to expand manufacturing capacity. It also scrutinized state support for the automotive industry and Seoul's handling of persistent oversupply in the petrochemical sector. The ministry said it had also emphasized to Washington that Korea's exports and investments in the United States contribute to American manufacturing competitiveness and supply chain stability. It submitted written comments, held consultations with the USTR and presented its position at public hearings as part of its efforts to challenge the findings. While the USTR proposed a tariff rate of up to 15 percent on Korean goods, it warned that the rate could rise to 25 percent if consultations fail to produce satisfactory results or Korea does not fulfill its commitments. The proposal is subject to further public consultation, with written comments due Jan. 5 and a public hearing scheduled for Jan. 25. Industry Minister Kim Jung-kwan noted that the U.S. side had reaffirmed ahead of the announcement that it would respect the bilateral tariff agreement in determining the final rate. “If we can ultimately maintain the 15 percent rate, I think that would be more than a good result,” Kim said. The ministry said that the government is not considering major changes to its industrial policies in response to the U.S. allegations, adding it will work with other ministries and industry groups to prepare counterarguments to the USTR’s claims in the report. Industry experts, however, said Korea would need to remain mindful of Washington's concerns while continuing its domestic investment plans. Lee Jong-hwan, a professor of system semiconductor engineering at Sangmyung University, said the U.S. criticism also reflects Washington's desire to attract more semiconductor investment. “The U.S. has consistently applied pressure for the same reason: It wants more investment in semiconductor production facilities on its soil," the professor said. “In reality, we cannot completely ignore the U.S. government's position.” He said Korea should proceed with its planned semiconductor investments to maintain its technological lead over China and U.S. competitors, while taking a flexible approach to additional investment in the U.S. "Korea's planned investments at home must go ahead … In semiconductors, making investments ahead of demand is important. It is crucial to check and secure mass-production readiness in advance," he said. “At the same time, given the pressure from the U.S., we need to respond flexibly by consulting with the U.S. government on investments that could bring more semiconductor production lines to the country.” Jang Sang-sik, head of trade trend analysis at the Korea International Trade Association, said Korea should emphasize that its growing trade surplus with the U.S. reflects strong American demand for semiconductors used to support the artificial intelligence (AI) industry, rather than deliberate excess production. "Korea needs to emphasize that its trade surplus has grown because semiconductor exports are supporting the U.S. AI industry," he said
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/oth.title_zh: 韩国反驳美国有关国家主导产能过剩的说法
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/oth.body_zh: 韩国正反驳华盛顿关于其产业政策导致制造业结构性产能过剩的说法。美国启动新的关税调查，引发外界担忧：支持韩国国内半导体生产的措施是否会面临进一步贸易压力。韩国贸易、工业和资源部周四表示，不认同美国贸易代表办公室（USTR）所引证据中的大部分内容，认为韩国的产业政策由市场需求和企业投资决策推动，并非政府试图将产能扩大至实际需求之上。该部强调，将努力维持去年韩美双边贸易协议约定的15%关税上限。一名该部官员在记者会上说：“USTR所引报告中相当一部分内容，我们无法认同。韩国的产业政策以市场经济为基础，由企业的投资需求驱动。政府支持的重点是增强企业的核心能力和建设更完善的基础设施。我们的立场是，这不能被视为由国家主导的结构性供应过剩。”该官员说：“美国论点中也有一些方面缺乏可靠的逻辑依据或依据不足，我们将积极向美方说明我们在这些问题上的立场。”此前，USTR于周三当地时间宣布，已认定包括韩国在内的14个经济体存在助长制造业产能过剩的做法，并依据其贸易法《第301条》提议加征关税。USTR代表杰米森·格里尔特别批评韩国的政府支持和基础设施计划，认为这些计划将在扩大海外供应的同时，却无法创造相应需求。格里尔在公告后接受CNBC采访时说：“这些事项并不回应实际需求，而是政府干预。它们在未实际扩大海外消费的情况下增加了海外供应。”USTR的调查报告将韩国计划在全南－光州特别 Metropolitan City 地区建设的半导体集群列为政府支持扩大制造业产能的实例。报告还审查了韩国政府对汽车业的支持，以及首尔如何应对石化行业长期存在的供应过剩。该部表示，它也曾向华盛顿强调，韩国对美国的出口和投资有助于提升美国制造业竞争力和供应链稳定性。为挑战调查结论，该部提交了书面意见，与USTR举行磋商，并在公开听证会上陈述立场。USTR虽然提议对韩国商品加征最高15%的关税，但警告称，如果磋商未能取得满意结果或韩国不履行承诺，税率可能升至25%。该提案还将进一步征求公众意见，书面意见截止日期为1月5日，公开听证会定于1月25日举行。产业部长金正官指出，美方在公告前已重申，将在确定最终税率时遵守双边关税协议。金正官说：“如果我们最终能够维持15%的税率，我认为这将是再好不过的结果。”该部表示，政府不打算因美国的指控而对产业政策作出重大调整，并称将与其他部委和行业团体合作，准备反驳USTR报告中的相关主张。然而，产业专家表示，韩国在继续推进国内投资计划的同时，仍需关注华盛顿的担忧。上明大学系统半导体工程教授李钟焕表示，美国的批评也反映出华盛顿希望吸引更多半导体投资的意图。这名教授说：“美国一直出于同样原因施压：它希望更多半导体生产设施投资落户美国。现实中，我们不能完全无视美国政府的立场。”他说，韩国应继续推进计划中的半导体投资，以保持相对于中国和美国竞争对手的技术领先，同时对在美追加投资采取灵活做法。李钟焕说：“韩国计划中的本土投资必须继续推进……在半导体领域，提前投资很重要。提前检查并确保具备量产能力至关重要。”他补充道：“与此同时，鉴于美国施加的压力，我们需要灵活应对，就可能为美国带来更多半导体生产线赴美投资的事宜与美国政府进行磋商。”韩国国际贸易协会贸易趋势分析主管张相植表示，韩国应强调，其对美贸易顺差增长反映的是美国对人工智能（AI）产业所用半导体的强劲需求，而非蓄意的过剩生产。他说：“韩国需要强调，贸易顺差增长是因为半导体出口在支持美国人工智能产业。”

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title: PM expresses gratitude to CSAT supervisors, promises to look for ways to lessen burden next year
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary: Prime Minister Han Seong-sook expressed gratitude Thursday to test supervisors at last week's annual college entrance exam, saying they must have remained on edge throughout the test due to a series of measures added to prevent cheating and that the government will look for ways to minimize their burden next year.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary_zh: 首相韩成淑周四向上周年度大学入学考试监考人员表示感谢。她说，为防止作弊而采取的一系列措施使监考人员在整个考试期间想必始终绷紧了神经，政府将在明年寻找减轻其负担的办法。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: Prime Minister Han Seong-sook expressed gratitude Thursday to test supervisors at last week's annual college entrance exam, saying they must have remained on edge throughout the test due to a series of measures added to prevent cheating and that the government will look for ways to minimize their burden next year. Thousands of additional personnel, usually school teachers, were mobilized to supervise the College Scholastic Ability Test (CSAT), known as Suneung in Korean, to enforce a series of anti-cheating measures, including checking test-takers' glasses and clothing. "This year's Suneung was an unfamiliar experience for both students and teachers," Han said on X. "As teachers checked the students' glasses and clothing, they likely remained on edge until the very end, anxious about whether anything had been overlooked, yet equally concerned that an unnecessary suspicion might hurt a student's feelings."
